node.label: Markets & indicators
node.summary: Sensex, Nifty, PMI and other quick indicators.

facts.text: Sensex rose 2.17% (1,718 pts) to **81,028.02** and Nifty 2.01% to **25,030.35** (highest since March 2) on Nov 6 — the Nifty's biggest weekly rally of 2026 (+6.8%) — even as the Nasdaq-100 fell **6.36%** on Nov 5 (wiping ~$2.53 trillion), on AI-infrastructure-spending fears after the US midterms; the rupee hit a 6-month high of **93.89**/$.
facts.plain: Sensex rose 2.17% (1,718 pts) to 81,028.02 and Nifty 2.01% to 25,030.35 (highest since March 2) on Nov 6 — the Nifty's biggest weekly rally of 2026 (+6.8%) — even as the Nasdaq-100 fell 6.36% on Nov 5 (wiping ~$2.53 trillion), on AI-infrastructure-spending fears after the US midterms; the rupee hit a 6-month high of 93.89/$.

facts.text: On 4 Nov, Sensex gained **383 points (0.5%)** to **77,301** and Nifty rose **149 points (0.6%)** to **23,960** — a fifth straight day of gains; India's VIX ('fear gauge') is up **65.4%** year-to-date despite easing from its late-October high of 17.

facts.text: Gold prices rose **3%** on 4 Nov as the US dollar index slipped to a **5-week low of 101.3** ahead of the US midterm results.
facts.plain: Gold prices rose 3% on 4 Nov as the US dollar index slipped to a 5-week low of 101.3 ahead of the US midterm results.

facts.text: **HSBC India Manufacturing PMI**: 54.7 in Oct (55.1 in Sept); export orders at a six-month high. A reading above 50 means expansion.
facts.plain: HSBC India Manufacturing PMI: 54.7 in Oct (55.1 in Sept); export orders at a six-month high. A reading above 50 means expansion.

facts.text: Sensex closed at **75,682.78** (+1,233) and Nifty 50 at **23,440** (+387.70), both up 1.7%. **Reliance** jumped 11.6% after Q2 FY27 results.
facts.plain: Sensex closed at 75,682.78 (+1,233) and Nifty 50 at 23,440 (+387.70), both up 1.7%. Reliance jumped 11.6% after Q2 FY27 results.

facts.text: Comex gold fell 7.26% in October to a one-year low of $3,884.9/ounce, while Comex silver dropped 19.1% to $49.13/ounce, as both precious metals posted negative returns for a second straight month.
facts.plain: Comex gold fell 7.26% in October to a one-year low of $3,884.9/ounce, while Comex silver dropped 19.1% to $49.13/ounce, as both precious metals posted negative returns for a second straight month.

facts.text: Foreign Portfolio Investors withdrew **₹34,843 crore** from Indian equities in October (second straight month of heavy outflows), per Central Depository Services data, amid concerns over crude oil prices and global interest rates.
facts.plain: Foreign Portfolio Investors withdrew ₹34,843 crore from Indian equities in October (second straight month of heavy outflows), per Central Depository Services data, amid concerns over crude oil prices and global interest rates.

facts.text: On 29 Oct the **Nifty** closed at **22,936.77** and the **Sensex** at **74,151.04**; the rupee touched **95.38/$** before closing at **95.26**.
